free_tier.correction: true — limited free Test Mode exists, although it is not an ongoing free production plan

free_tier_limits.correction: 100 KB of data and up to 10 device-originated SMS messages within 90 days; reaching any limit automatically activates the paid plan

rate_limits.correction: Rate limiting is enforced on all API requests; exceeding it returns HTTP 429, and clients should wait 5–10 seconds before retrying. No numeric request quota is stated.

notes: The API remains active and retains its v1 base URL. The submitted documentation URL leads to the legacy Apiary site; Hologram announced its replacement in October 2025. Current detailed documentation gives 90-day Test Mode limits, while a marketing page says testing may last up to 12 months, possibly reflecting contracted configurations.
